summary: P0 Features Iteration 125 Complete - 19/19 backend tests PASSED. UI verified: Talent CRM Kanban (7 columns, 5 seed contacts), Team Outreach (4 tabs), One-Click Apply dialog. All features functional.

tabs_verified.collaborate: Candidate picker with 5 CRM contacts, search input, comment thread area
tabs_verified.outreach: Recipient picker, channel selector (Email/SMS/InMail), subject line, message textarea, send button
tabs_verified.templates: 3 templates displayed with 'Use' action buttons, 'New Template' button

critical_code_review_comments: TalentCRMPage.jsx: Kanban board implementation using HTML5 Drag and Drop API is clean with proper state management
TeamOutreachPage.jsx: Good use of credentials: 'include' for cookie-based auth, clean tab structure
App.js ApplyDialog: One-Click Apply button properly handles already_applied, success, and error states with visual feedback
talent_tools.py: One-click apply correctly checks for existing applications before creating new one
talent_crm.py: PUT /contacts/{id}/stage validates stage against PIPELINE_STAGES array
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 features (One-Click Apply, Team Outreach, Kanban Pipeline) fully tested and working. Login uses ?portal=jobs param to skip portal selector, then email-submit-btn for login. Kanban board supports drag-and-drop via HTML5 DnD API. Team Outreach uses cookie auth (credentials: 'include'). 5 seed contacts exist across different pipeline stages.

mocked_apis_list: Outreach send (POST /api/talent-tools/outreach/send) - creates DB records but no actual email/SMS sent
One-click apply (POST /api/talent-tools/one-click-apply) - creates application record, no external job board redirect
mocked_apis.note: Mocked as per design - APIs work correctly for UI demonstration and data persistence
